brandbook.positioning: Herramienta ficticia de trabajo personal para guardar y recuperar notas privadas sin crear una cuenta. Descripción exacta: «Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.»
brandbook.voice: Español claro, breve y directo. Etiquetas que explican acciones y estados reales, sin lenguaje comercial, promesas inventadas ni tecnicismos de persistencia en la interfaz habitual.
brandbook.motif: Bolsillo con hoja como símbolo compacto; en el espacio de trabajo, el índice y la hoja comparten un borde funcional que mantiene juntas selección, edición y confirmación. No añadir texturas de papel, costuras ornamentales ni ilustraciones de relleno.

pages.title: Brand guidelines
pages.summary: Herramienta ficticia de trabajo personal para guardar y recuperar notas privadas sin crear una cuenta. Descripción exacta: «Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.»

examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Cover composition
examples.text: Keep a 32 px outer margin. Give the name more space than the descriptor; do not turn the cover into a product promotion.

pages.title: The Brand
pages.summary: Use Action Blue for this divider, with white type and one compact symbol. Introduce a working environment, not a commercial landing page.

examples.title: Un espacio para tus notas
examples.text: Consulta el resumen, elige una nota y continúa escribiendo.

examples.title: Divider rhythm
examples.text: Align the heading and short introduction to the same left edge used throughout the guide.

pages.title: Welcome
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.title: Project basis
examples.text: Preserve Notas de Bolsillo and its exact description: Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Reading this guide
examples.text: Apply the pocket symbol, blue-gray desk and shared working edge consistently. Studies describe intended presentation, not implemented features.

pages.title: Index
pages.summary: Keep the guide in five consecutive sections. Use small page ranges and clear headings rather than a dense decorative contents grid.

examples.title: Identity · 01–15
examples.text: Introduction, editorial direction and the pocket-with-sheet mark.

examples.title: Visual system · 16–29
examples.text: Typography 16–22 · Color 23–25 · Graphic language 26–29.

examples.title: Applications · 30–49
examples.text: Design studies for the workspace, small-format identity, supporting materials and in-app help.

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Define the identity through an index beside an active sheet. The shared border links selection, writing and confirmed state without decorative cards.

examples.title: Tu bolsillo
examples.text: Use this heading for the personal overview on Inicio, not as a promotional hero.

examples.title: Título · Texto — opcional
examples.text: Keep writing fields complete and readable on a white sheet beside the note index.

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Express project intent, not an invented corporate mission. Describe the specific task: working with personal notes in an anonymous session without an account.

examples.title: Task statement
examples.text: Crea, busca y edita tus notas sin iniciar sesión.

examples.title: Honest boundary
examples.text: Tus notas dependen de conservar la cookie de esta sesión. No hay recuperación mediante una cuenta.

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Treat clarity, continuity and restraint as design criteria, not claimed company values. Make each visible through labels, retained context and limited ornament.

examples.title: Clarity
examples.text: Write Guardar nota, not Listo. State the action before asking the visitor to commit.

examples.title: Continuity
examples.text: Keep the selected note and unsaved text visible after a failed save. Place recovery beside the working state.

examples.title: Restraint
examples.text: Use one shared border between index and sheet. Omit paper textures, stitched pockets and repeated dashboard cards.

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write interface copy in brief, direct Spanish. Name actions and observed states; avoid marketing claims, blame and database terminology in everyday messages.

examples.title: Validation
examples.text: Escribe un título. El texto es opcional.

examples.title: Recoverable failure
examples.text: No se pudo guardar la nota. Tus cambios siguen aquí.

examples.title: Uncertain result
examples.text: No sabemos si se guardó. Recupera el resultado antes de volver a enviar.

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the logo chapter on Clean Paper. Show the original pocket-with-sheet symbol and the separately typeset name; do not embed lettering in the SVG.

examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo
examples.text: A blue pocket holds a white emerging sheet. The full name sits beside it in IBM Plex Sans 600.

examples.title: Chapter composition
examples.text: Keep one large lockup and one short caption. Avoid a wall of repeated marks.

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The symbol combines a folded sheet with an open pocket. Preserve its rounded lower contour and strong horizontal opening; these distinguish it from a folder or shield.

examples.title: Workspace signature
examples.text: Use the pocket-with-sheet symbol in the header, paired with Notas de Bolsillo.

examples.title: Geometric continuity
examples.text: Reuse the supplied SVG paths exactly. Do not replace the pocket with a library icon in compact layouts.

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Use a horizontal lockup: 32 px symbol, 8 px gap and a 20 px name in weight 600. Align optical centers; keep the name as live typography.

examples.title: Header lockup
examples.text: Notas de Bolsillo appears in Ink beside the Action Blue symbol on the pale desk or white header.

examples.title: Narrow layout
examples.text: Reduce the name to 18 px before changing composition. Let navigation adapt separately; never squeeze the symbol.

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Let x equal one quarter of the symbol canvas width. Keep at least x around standalone marks and complete lockups; navigation and borders stay outside this zone.

examples.title: 32 px header symbol
examples.text: Reserve 8 px of clear space around the lockup. Its internal symbol-to-name gap is also 8 px.

examples.title: 64 px display symbol
examples.text: Leave 16 px between the mark and any frame, caption or adjacent graphic.

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Keep the original blue-and-white symbol unchanged. On Action Blue or Ink, add a Clean Paper support surface so every outer edge remains visible.

examples.title: Light header
examples.text: Use the original symbol with an Ink wordmark on Clean Paper or Desk Mist.

examples.title: Dark divider
examples.text: Place the symbol on a white support square with clear space. Set Notas de Bolsillo separately in white.

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the symbol alone only where the app name is already established or supplied accessibly. Preserve the 160 × 160 canvas and its proportions at every size.

examples.title: Compact identity
examples.text: A 24–32 px symbol may identify the app in constrained chrome; its accessible name is Notas de Bolsillo.

examples.title: Application icon
examples.text: Center the exact geometry on Clean Paper. Add support padding rather than cropping the pocket tip.

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, recolor or decorate the mark. Never merge the name into its pocket, add shadows or replace the folded sheet with an initial.

examples.title: Wrong: decorative pocket
examples.text: Do not add stitching, denim textures or a handwritten N. The geometry is the identity.

examples.title: Wrong: blue-on-blue
examples.text: Do not place the mark directly on Action Blue. Restore the white support surface instead of recoloring its paths.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Open the type chapter with one working headline and one sentence. Use IBM Plex Sans throughout; hierarchy comes from size, weight and spacing, not extra families.

examples.title: Tu bolsillo
examples.text: Tus notas recientes y fijadas, en un mismo resumen.

examples.title: Chapter setting
examples.text: Set the headline at 32 px and supporting copy at 16 px, separated by 12 px.

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Use IBM Plex Sans for identity, navigation, fields and metadata. Keep sentence case, Spanish accents and normal letter spacing across the interface.

examples.title: Selecciona una nota
examples.text: Elige una nota de la lista o crea una nueva.

examples.title: One-family system
examples.text: Avoid uppercase navigation and condensed labels. Use space and weight to separate Inicio, Notas and the selected title.

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: IBM Plex Sans is the selected family. Supplied distributable files cover 400, 500, 600 and 700; the app specification uses local hosting with the font license.

examples.title: Escribe a tu ritmo
examples.text: Añade un título y, si quieres, un texto. Guarda cuando termines.

examples.title: Fallback treatment
examples.text: If loading fails, use a system sans-serif fallback while preserving sizes and wrapping. The fallback is not the identity typeface.

pages.title: Weights & styles
pages.summary: Use 600 for app identity and headings, 400 for body and fields, and 500 for navigation and actions. Weight 700 belongs to guide display headings, not routine app controls.

examples.title: Guardar nota
examples.text: El título es obligatorio. El texto es opcional.

examples.title: Weight specimen
examples.text: Notas de Bolsillo: 600. Guardar nota: 500. Texto escrito por la persona: 400. Do not use bold to imply a successful save.

examples.title: Style restraint
examples.text: Use upright text for errors, hints and dates. Avoid decorative italics, forced capitals and artificially synthesized weights.

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use the same family for secondary information at 12–14 px. Quiet Navy supports dates and hints; do not lower opacity until essential text becomes faint.

examples.title: Texto — opcional
examples.text: Puedes guardar la nota solo con un título.

examples.title: Metadata treatment
examples.text: Show the server-provided date at 14 px beneath a recent note. Keep field labels at 16 px rather than styling them as metadata.

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Set page titles at 32/40 px on desktop and 26/34 px on narrow screens. Use 16/24 px for fields and body, and 14–16 px for navigation. Allow long titles to wrap.

examples.title: Ideas para la próxima semana
examples.text: Anota lo que quieres recordar y vuelve cuando lo necesites.

examples.title: Reading order
examples.text: Page heading → working state and primary action → field label → content → supporting date. Do not make metadata compete with the title.

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use a 4/8/12/16/24/32 px spacing scale. Inicio is an asymmetric overview; /notas is an index beside a white sheet. Share alignment, not identical compositions.

examples.title: Tu bolsillo
examples.text: Consulta tus notas fijadas y tus modificaciones recientes.

examples.title: Desktop and tablet
examples.text: At 1440 px, use a 320 px index and shared vertical border. At 768 px, use a 240 px index with 16 px separation.

examples.title: 390 px workspace
examples.text: Alternate list and editor. Use a 56 px header, 44 px return row and working edge up to 88 px; keep the start of the text visible.

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Use Action Blue for the color divider and Clean Paper for its copy. Present the palette as a working desk system rather than a collection of decorative swatches.

examples.title: Azul para actuar
examples.text: El escritorio organiza. La hoja deja espacio para escribir.

examples.title: Divider balance
examples.text: Keep one short statement on the blue field. Introduce the full token list on the following page.

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all five palette hex values. Quiet Navy is secondary text, not a border substitute. Keep Functional Border #748195 as an additional token.

examples.title: Workspace surfaces
examples.text: Desk Mist #EDF1F6: canvas. Clean Paper #FFFFFF: active sheet. Action Blue #2457C5: primary controls and selected emphasis.

examples.title: Readable structure
examples.text: Ink #172338: primary text. Quiet Navy #18345E: secondary text. Functional Border #748195: field boundaries and working divisions.

examples.title: State pairing
examples.text: Use white text on Action Blue for Guardar nota. Pair any additional semantic state color with a label and icon, never color alone.

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Prefer the supplied Desk Mist over arbitrary pale blues. Reserve translucent accents for nonessential hover fills; text, field borders and focus indicators remain solid.

examples.title: Selected note
examples.text: Use a Desk Mist row with an Action Blue edge and a visible selected state. Do not rely on a barely tinted background alone.

examples.title: Field boundary
examples.text: Keep #748195 solid against Clean Paper for a clear boundary. Do not fade the border to make the sheet appear cleaner.

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: The shared working edge is the main graphic device. Use functional rules and 4 px corner radii; omit textures, ornamental seams and floating decorative shapes.

examples.title: Editor edge
examples.text: Keep note identity, current state and Guardar nota in one top band. Fields continue directly beneath it.

examples.title: Confirmed movement
examples.text: After a confirmed pin change, reorder in 180 ms while retaining selection and focus. Reduced motion uses an immediate update and the same announcement.

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use consistent 20 px interface icons with visible action labels where space allows. Give interactive targets at least 44 px; the brand symbol is not an action icon.

examples.title: Fijar nota
examples.text: Pair a pin icon with Fijar nota or Desfijar nota. Show the confirmed state, not an optimistic change.

examples.title: Eliminar nota
examples.text: Pair the deletion icon with its label. Use an AlertDialog before deletion; an icon alone must not conceal the consequence.

pages.title: Photography
pages.summary: Do not use photography or filler illustration. Let the white writing surface carry the composition; demonstrations use clearly fictional content, never private visitor notes.

examples.title: Empty Inicio
examples.text: Show Todavía no tienes notas with the single creation action. Do not fill the space with a lifestyle photograph.

examples.title: Guide specimen only
examples.text: Ideas para la próxima semana may illustrate a note in this guide. It must not become preloaded content for a new visitor.

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build the reference board from palette fields, type, the pocket silhouette and an index-sheet seam. Exclude commercial dashboards, stationery textures and repeated card grids.

examples.title: Working materials
examples.text: Place a Desk Mist field beside a Clean Paper sheet, an Action Blue control and a narrow Functional Border.

examples.title: Recognizable atmosphere
examples.text: Use a calm left-aligned title, compact counters and a broad writing area. Recognition comes from structure rather than decoration.

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: All following applications are design studies. Carry the same symbol, type and working edge into each format without implying new routes, services or implemented features.

examples.title: Tus notas, a mano
examples.text: Abre el resumen o continúa en el espacio de notas.

examples.title: Application boundary
examples.text: Only Inicio at / and Notas at /notas are planned visual pages. Supporting materials do not introduce accounts, payments or extra screens.

pages.title: Social media icons
pages.summary: For avatar design studies, center the unchanged mark on Clean Paper. Keep the entire pocket inside a circular crop and omit tiny lettering.

examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Avatar crop
examples.text: At 160 px, place the SVG at 112 px with 24 px support padding. Check the pocket tip stays inside the circular safe area.

pages.title: Social media profiles
pages.summary: Profile design studies use the exact app name and description. Keep banners typographic; do not invent handles, follower counts or links to unplanned services.

examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Profile hierarchy
examples.text: Use the symbol as avatar, the full name as display name and a quiet blue-gray banner. Avoid promotional badges.

pages.title: Instagram posts
pages.summary: Post design studies use one short Spanish headline and a simplified workspace fragment. Keep specimen notes visibly fictional and avoid claims of released functionality.

examples.title: Una hoja para cada idea
examples.text: Añade un título. El texto puede esperar.

examples.title: Square composition
examples.text: Use a 32 px inset, a large left-aligned headline and one white sheet fragment. Keep the symbol secondary and omit decorative photography.

pages.title: Posters
pages.summary: Poster design studies enlarge the pocket and one line of copy. Use a blue-gray field, strong left alignment and generous blank space; do not invent event details.

examples.title: Haz sitio a una idea
examples.text: Notas de Bolsillo · Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Poster structure
examples.text: Place the name above the headline and the supported symbol below. Do not add fake dates, addresses or QR destinations.

pages.title: T shirts and totes
pages.summary: Textile design studies use the original two-color symbol on a white print support. Keep the name separate and omit sales information or merchandise claims.

examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo
examples.text: Un espacio para escribir.

examples.title: Placement
examples.text: Use a small chest lockup or a centered tote composition. On dark fabric, preserve the white support rather than changing the blue geometry.

pages.title: Note sleeves
pages.summary: Adapt packaging to a paper-sleeve design study for presentation sheets. Use the pocket contour once on the front; this is collateral, not an app export or delivery service.

examples.title: Ideas en papel
examples.text: Notas de Bolsillo · Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Sleeve layout
examples.text: Use a white sleeve, blue symbol and Ink name. Keep folds outside the mark safezone and avoid simulated stitching.

pages.title: Note entry points
pages.summary: Adapt pickup wayfinding to finding and opening notes. This design study makes the row title the entry point to its exact note; no extra destination page is introduced.

examples.title: Selecciona una nota
examples.text: Elige una nota de la lista para abrirla.

examples.title: List wayfinding
examples.text: Align title, excerpt and server date within each row. Preserve search and list position when returning from the mobile editor.

pages.title: Editor controls
pages.summary: The control design study uses shadcn/ui patterns with 4 px radii and 44 px targets. Keep Save primary; pin and delete remain secondary and act only on saved notes.

examples.title: Guardar nota
examples.text: Escribe un título. El texto es opcional.

examples.title: Control states
examples.text: Block duplicate submission while saving. After an error, keep Guardar nota activatable; use Recuperar guardado as primary for an uncertain result.

examples.title: Visible field error
examples.text: Place Escribe un título beside Título and in a linked error summary. Mark the field invalid and move focus to it when appropriate.

pages.title: Save confirmation
pages.summary: Replace a receipt with an in-context confirmation design study. Show success only after the server confirms; keep it in the editor edge and remove it immediately on further editing.

examples.title: Nota guardada
examples.text: Puedes seguir editando o volver a tus notas.

examples.title: Confirmation hierarchy
examples.text: Place the actual returned date beside the status in secondary type. Do not add a receipt page, fabricated timestamp or automatic redirect.

pages.title: Quick-reference card
pages.summary: Replace rewards with a noncommercial reference-card design study. Use concise action guidance; include no points, membership tiers or incentives.

examples.title: Crear, guardar, volver
examples.text: Nueva nota abre un borrador. Guardar nota confirma tus cambios.

examples.title: Card hierarchy
examples.text: Set one headline at 26 px and three short instructions at 16 px. Use Action Blue only for the action labels.

pages.title: Workspace sign
pages.summary: Adapt venue signage to a presentation placard design study. Keep the name dominant and the description secondary; do not imply a physical office or public venue.

examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Distance reading
examples.text: Use the horizontal lockup on white with generous clear space. Avoid small navigation labels or a fabricated street address.

pages.title: App website
pages.summary: Website design studies cover only / and /notas. Inicio shows the real personal summary; Notas joins index and editor. Use the exact description once on each page.

examples.title: Todavía no tienes notas
examples.text: Crear mi primera nota

examples.title: Inicio composition
examples.text: Place Tu bolsillo above compact counters, broad recent notes and a narrow pinned column. On mobile, pinned notes come first. Only confirmed emptiness shows zeros.

examples.title: Editor and navigation
examples.text: Keep Inicio and Notas accessible with aria-current. At 390 px, alternate list and sheet without a bottom dock; protect pending edits before navigation.

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: The favicon design study reuses the exact original SVG geometry on a white support surface. Preserve square proportions; do not substitute initials or a template icon.

examples.title: Notas — Notas de Bolsillo
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Small-size identity
examples.text: Use the same pocket in the header and app/icon.svg. Derive larger application icons with support padding, not new paths.

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Stationery design studies use a quiet top-left lockup and a single functional rule. Keep the content area open; omit invented contact details, offices or legal entities.

examples.title: Una idea por desarrollar
examples.text: Título · Texto opcional

examples.title: Sheet composition
examples.text: Use 32 px margins, a small lockup and a #748195 divider. Avoid ruled-paper textures that compete with the written content.

pages.title: Project cards
pages.summary: Adapt business cards to project-introduction design studies. Show the app name and exact descriptor; do not invent a role, surname, email address or phone number for Esteban.

examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Front and back
examples.text: Use the supported symbol on an Action Blue front. On the white reverse, align the name and descriptor with at least 8 px separation.

pages.title: Blank-note card
pages.summary: Replace gift cards with a blank writing-card design study. Provide a writing invitation without monetary value, redemption mechanics or preloaded app content.

examples.title: ¿Qué quieres recordar?
examples.text: Empieza por un título.

examples.title: Writing space
examples.text: Keep most of the card white. Put the prompt at the top and a small pocket symbol at the bottom, outside the writing area.

pages.title: Folder seal
pages.summary: Adapt packaging seals to a presentation-folder sticker design study. Use the supported pocket alone; never present the seal as certification, security proof or a trust badge.

examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Seal geometry
examples.text: Center the original mark in a white circle with generous padding. Keep any separate caption outside the circle; do not bend type around the pocket.

pages.title: In-app help
pages.summary: Help design studies stay inside the two planned pages. Explain session limits and recoverable states beside the affected task; do not invent a support team, account recovery or help route.

examples.title: No se pudo iniciar la sesión
examples.text: El navegador debe permitir la cookie de sesión para abrir tus notas. Reintentar.

examples.title: Hay cambios sin guardar
examples.text: Antes de salir, elige Guardar, Descartar o Continuar editando.

examples.title: ¿Eliminar esta nota?
examples.text: Esta acción no se puede deshacer. Cancelar · Eliminar nota

pages.title: Thank you
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo
examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.

examples.title: Colophon
examples.text: Original pocket geometry for this project. IBM Plex Sans in supplied weights 400, 500, 600 and 700. Application studies are not evidence of implemented features.

examples.title: Closing rule
examples.text: Keep the final page quiet: one lockup, one descriptor and a small source block. Do not add a sales call to action.
